crs.name: Purdue project building-local meters; X east, Y north, Z up

source_crs: EPSG:2968, US survey feet; normalized height converted to meters

properties.method: 2018 5-ft NDHM cells polygonized within official GIS FID 642; transformed into building local frame and clipped outside saved source shell bounds; simplified 0.65m; height set to outside-shell band median.
properties.uncertainty: Coarse roof/wall envelope only. Raster height does not distinguish floors, parapets, canopies, or exact wall line. No room layout, facade openings, or story claims.
